QUOTE: With asm, it is an empty `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))`, so the compiler cannot prove the value.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the asm path is an empty `asm volatile` with the value as a "+r" in/out operand. It also says the point is to stop the compiler from reasoning about the value, which is the optimisation-barrier purpose.
